CREATE TABLE Sales_hash
(
    cust_id INT,
    prod_id INT,
    amount INT
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = HASH(cust_id),
    CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
);

CREATE TABLE Sales_RR
(
    cust_id INT,
    prod_id INT,
    amount INT
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    CLUSTERED COLUMNSTORE INDEX
);

CREATE TABLE PRODUCT
(
    prod_id INT,
    prod_name VARCHAR(100)
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = REPLICATE
);

INSERT INTO Sales_hash SELECT
101, 1, 500
UNION ALL SELECT 102, 2, 1500
UNION ALL SELECT 103, 3, 250
UNION ALL SELECT 104, 4, 750
UNION ALL SELECT 105, 5, 3000
UNION ALL SELECT 106, 6, 125;

drop table Sales_hash

INSERT INTO Sales_RR SELECT
101, 1, 500
UNION ALL SELECT 102, 2, 1500
UNION ALL SELECT 103, 3, 250
UNION ALL SELECT 104, 4, 750
UNION ALL SELECT 105, 5, 3000
UNION ALL SELECT 106, 6, 125;

INSERT INTO PRODUCT SELECT 1, 'Laptop'
UNION ALL SELECT 2, 'Mobile'
UNION ALL SELECT 3, 'Tablet'
UNION ALL SELECT 4, 'Monitor';

select SUM(amount) as total_revenue from Sales_hash

CREATE TABLE Sales_heap
(
    cust_id INT,
    prod_id INT,
    amount INT
)
WITH
(
    DISTRIBUTION = ROUND_ROBIN,
    HEAP
);

select * from Sales_hash
